# GreenPoint Maintenance Services Corp

> MBE-certified commercial janitorial and facility maintenance company serving NY, NJ, CT, PA, and FL since 2018. NYC DOE Approved Vendor, SAM.gov registered, bonded and insured. Specializes in schools, healthcare, government, daycare, churches, and commercial facilities. Differentiated by JaniTrack — a proprietary photo, GPS, and ATP bioluminescence verification system that documents every cleaning visit.

## Company Information

- Legal name: GreenPoint Maintenance Services Corp
- Founded: 2018
- Address: 1420 Outlook Ave, Apt 2, Bronx, NY 10465
- Phone: 347-332-9348
- Email: info@greenpointms.com
- Website: https://greenpointms.com
- Owner / President: Miguel Garcia
- NAICS Codes: 561720 (Janitorial Services), 238210 (Electrical Contractors), 561790 (Other Services to Buildings)
- Service area: New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, Florida

## Certifications

- MBE (Minority Business Enterprise) certified
- MWBE (Minority and Women-Owned Business Enterprise) certified
- NYC DOE (Department of Education) Approved Vendor
- SAM.gov registered for federal contracting
- Bonded and insured

## Core Services

- [Commercial Janitorial Services](https://greenpointms.com/janitorial-services-nyc): Daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning programs for commercial facilities
- [School Cleaning](https://greenpointms.com/school-cleaning-nyc): K-12 specialized cleaning programs, NYC DOE compliant
- [Government Cleaning Services](https://greenpointms.com/government-cleaning-services): Federal, state, and municipal facility maintenance
- [MBE-Certified Cleaning](https://greenpointms.com/mbe-certified-cleaning-company-nyc): Diversity-spend qualified procurement
- [Disinfection Services](https://greenpointms.com/blog/electrostatic-disinfection-explained): Electrostatic spraying, EPA-registered disinfectants, ATP-verified results
- [Floor Care](https://greenpointms.com/blog/vct-floor-care-strip-seal-wax-guide): VCT strip/seal/wax, carpet extraction, hard surface maintenance
- [Day Porter Services](https://greenpointms.com/blog/restroom-cleaning-best-practices-high-traffic): On-site cleaning during business hours for high-traffic facilities
- [Post-Construction Cleanup](https://greenpointms.com/blog/post-construction-cleaning-phases-explained): Three-phase cleanup for new construction and renovation
- Facility Maintenance: General building upkeep and repairs

## Industries Served

- K-12 schools, charter schools, and educational facilities
- Healthcare and medical offices (HIPAA, OSHA compliant)
- Government buildings (federal, state, municipal)
- Daycare and childcare facilities (Health Department compliant)
- Churches, synagogues, mosques, and houses of worship
- Commercial offices and Class A buildings
- Assisted living and senior care facilities
- Coworking spaces
- Warehouses and industrial facilities

## Key Differentiators

- **JaniTrack verification system**: Proprietary technology that captures photo evidence, GPS-stamped location, time-stamped task completion, and ATP bioluminescence test readings for every cleaning visit. Provides facility managers with verifiable proof that cleaning was performed to standard.
- **48-hour proposal turnaround**: Fixed-price proposals delivered within 48 hours of facility walkthrough.
- **MBE/MWBE certified**: Helps clients meet diversity procurement goals and unlocks set-aside contracts.
- **NYC DOE Approved Vendor**: Pre-qualified to bid on New York City school district contracts.
- **5-state coverage**: Single vendor for multi-state facility portfolios.
- **Photo + GPS + ATP verified**: Three independent forms of cleaning verification on every visit.

## Compliance & Standards Expertise

GreenPoint operates in compliance with:

- OSHA Hazard Communication Standard (cleaning chemicals, GHS labels, SDS requirements)
- OSHA Bloodborne Pathogens Standard (medical office cleaning)
- HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules (healthcare facility cleaning)
- ADA accessibility requirements
- EPA disinfectant registration and List N/List K guidelines
- NFPA fire codes for chemical storage
- Davis-Bacon Act and Service Contract Act prevailing wage requirements
- NY Local Laws 11, 26, 34, and 97
- ISSA Cleaning Industry Standards (5-level appearance scale)
- GSA cleaning standards for government buildings
